findings.issue:
The H1 wraps to four lines at every lg+ width with the two-word "pristup." orphaned on line four. With text-balance dropped and the manual
s kept, the third written line ("Jedan pažljiv pristup.", 48px italic) cannot fit the 5fr column, which is ~377px at 1024 and ~430px at 1440 — so this is not an edge case, it is every desktop. The code comment claims the italic's "last two words want to stay together"; the render splits them. Either shorten the line, drop the third
and let the balancer choose, or widen the type column.

findings.issue: The closing navy band restates the sentence immediately above it. Lokacije ends with "Obje ordinacije primaju upite kroz isto Instagram sanduče. Grad, termin i sve ostalo dogovarate u toj jednoj poruci." and ~270px later the closing lede says "Upit stiže u Instagram poruke ordinacije. Tu se dogovara termin — u Igalu ili u Zelenici." Same three facts, same order, adjacent on screen. One of the two should carry different information or be cut.
findings.evidence: .tmp/shots-after/dental-clinic-kovacevic-desktop.png, the two paragraphs at y≈3160 and y≈3430; on phone they are consecutive screens (y≈4180 and y≈4300).

findings.issue: The page's declared signature mark does not read as the mark it cites. Printed at 256px on the closing field it reads as a heart with an angular scribble and a round stroke-cap hanging free in mid-air where the crown fails to close. The source mark, shown on the same page one screen above, is a tapering brush crown with a shallow S-dip and three shrinking elliptical screw coils, with its open terminal on the opposite side. A viewer comparing the two would not read them as the same glyph — which undercuts the whole "nothing here says dentistry" fix.
findings.evidence: Desktop AFTER x1250-1440 / y3420-3720 (large print) compared against the door plate in phone AFTER at y≈2914-3122 and desktop AFTER x965-1163 / y2350-2560. The 30px flow marks (desktop AFTER, y≈1375-1425) read acceptably; the large print does not.

findings.issue: The page's density peak is carried by two identical unloaded-map plates. Each cell holds a 224px graph-paper rectangle containing the byte-identical sentence "Mapa se otvara tek na klik i pretražuje ime ordinacije u gradu." plus identically-labelled "Prikaži mapu" and "Otvori u Google Mapama" controls — four controls and two verbatim-duplicate sentences in one band. Every other demo in the repo uses MapEmbed exactly once. The note belongs once under the board (or merged into the honest closing sentence), and one plate would carry the idea. The plate frames are also square-cornered against the page's stated one-6px-radius rule.
findings.evidence: Desktop AFTER y≈2800-3060 (side by side, duplication unmissable); tablet AFTER y≈3520-3780; phone AFTER y≈3620-3760 and y≈3770-3910, where the two plates add ~500px of placeholder to a page that grew 3781→4726px.

findings.issue: Prva posjeta's wide column still has an empty right third — the declared deviation. The hero photograph lost its figure/figcaption, so the hand-painted wall lettering — the stated reason the frame was chosen — is never named in visible copy, only in alt text. roomPhoto.caption was rewritten per the plan and is then rendered nowhere, leaving unused data behind.
findings.evidence: Desktop AFTER hero, y≈90-640: no caption under the plate, unlike the door plate at y≈2560 which keeps its figcaption.

findings.issue: The longest doctor name has ~2px of slack at 390px. "Sanja Kovačević-Ožegović" at 1.7rem ends at x≈348 in a 350px content box, so on 360px and 375px phones it wraps or hyphen-breaks to two lines while the other two names stay single — reintroducing the ragged roster on smaller devices.

findings.issue: The "Napiši prvu poruku ↗" link's underline breaks in two: inline-flex plus gap-1.5 means the underline stops at the text, skips the gap, and restarts under the arrow. The map links in the same section have a continuous rule, so the page shows two different treatments of the same idiom.
findings.evidence: Desktop AFTER y≈1540-1560; clearer in the phone crop at y≈1920, where the arrow's underline segment is visibly detached.

findings.issue: The town pair is named five times in running copy (hero lede, secondary CTA, flow step 2, the Lokacije lede plus the board itself, and the closing lede), and the "one message" idea four times. With only five sections, the repetition is noticeable and makes the page feel like one sentence rewritten.
findings.evidence: Full-page desktop AFTER scan; most obvious between y≈2400 and y≈3450 where "Igalo/Zelenika" appears four times in one screen and a half.

overall: This is a real rebuild, not a claim-and-move-on: the BEFORE/AFTER pair shows the four repeated ~500px right-hand voids genuinely gone, the hero is now the strongest frame in the set (sharp room, the clinic's own painted script inside the crop, a measured 64px container break, bottom edges resolved to the pixel), the accent has a written and obeyed deployment rule, the motion budget is zero, the roster alignment bug is fixed, and the data-layer ethic survives untouched — nothing researchOnly forbids reaches the render, and the map plates search rather than assert. Three things keep it just short of the best four: the H1 orphans a word on every desktop width, the closing band restates the paragraph directly above it, and the page's density peak is carried by two identical unloaded-map placeholders while its declared signature mark, printed at 256px, reads as a heart with a dangling stroke rather than the door glyph it cites one screen above. All three are contained fixes — a line break, a deleted paragraph, one fewer map plate, and a re-trace — and none require re-planning.
